# The House Always Wins

> A rigged fact-check game about Ohio's public-school funding. Every claim below is labeled Fact or Fiction and linked to its source. Published by Ohioans United for Public Education.

Site: https://ohio-gameshow.netlify.app

## The Tax Plan
- **Eliminating Ohio's income tax would barely dent the state budget.** — Verdict: Fiction. It's a $9.82 billion-a-year hole — 21% of the entire General Revenue Fund. (Source: Tiffin Ohio — https://tiffinohio.net/posts/report-ramaswamy-tax-plan-would-gut-ohio-schools-medicaid/)
- **The income-tax hole is bigger than Ohio's entire share of Medicaid.** — Verdict: Fact. The $9.8B loss exceeds the whole $8B state Medicaid share. (Source: Tiffin Ohio — https://tiffinohio.net/posts/report-ramaswamy-tax-plan-would-gut-ohio-schools-medicaid/)
- **A typical $60K Ohio worker would save about $100 a month from the income-tax cut.** — Verdict: Fact. True — but it's eaten by higher property/sales taxes and lost services. (Source: Tiffin Ohio — https://tiffinohio.net/posts/report-ramaswamy-tax-plan-would-gut-ohio-schools-medicaid/)
- **Ohioans would lose roughly $832 per person, per year, in state revenue.** — Verdict: Fact. That's the per-capita income-tax revenue eliminated (population ~11.8M). (Source: Innovation Ohio (report) — https://static1.squarespace.com/static/67dc94ee5e35aa4eb80d7b0c/t/6994cf6fefe31c5a7a120e1e/1771360111523/Report+What+Vivek+Ramaswamy%E2%80%99s+Income+Tax+Plan+Would+Mean+for+Ohio.pdf)
- **His property-tax rollback is just a modest tweak.** — Verdict: Fiction. It's $4.0B now, ~$6.6B at implementation — about 60% of all state income-tax revenue. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/ramaswamys-property-tax-scam)
- **The rollback puts 3,190 voter-approved police, fire, and EMS levies at risk.** — Verdict: Fact. Townships collect $1.5B/yr in property tax and have no other major revenue source. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/ramaswamys-property-tax-scam)
- **Ramaswamy has named a way to replace the lost revenue.** — Verdict: Fiction. “No replacement revenue identified” appears verbatim in both reports. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/ramaswamys-property-tax-scam)
- **Ohio can just grow its way out of it — it worked in Kansas.** — Verdict: Fiction. Kansas' 2012 tax-cut experiment brought cuts, downgrades, and a GOP-led reversal in 2017. (Source: Innovation Ohio (report) — https://static1.squarespace.com/static/67dc94ee5e35aa4eb80d7b0c/t/6994cf6fefe31c5a7a120e1e/1771360111523/Report+What+Vivek+Ramaswamy%E2%80%99s+Income+Tax+Plan+Would+Mean+for+Ohio.pdf)

## Who Cashes In
- **Most of the benefit from his capital-gains cut goes to people earning over $1 million a year.** — Verdict: Fact. 55.6% flows to ~15,000 top earners; just 7.3% to the two-thirds of Ohioans under $200K. (Source: Tiffin Ohio — https://tiffinohio.net/posts/report-ramaswamy-tax-plan-would-gut-ohio-schools-medicaid/)
- **Selling just 1% of his portfolio, Vivek would save about $825,000 in Ohio tax.** — Verdict: Fact. On ~$30M of appreciated stock at Ohio's 2.75% flat rate. Net worth: $3.1B (Forbes). (Source: Tiffin Ohio — https://tiffinohio.net/posts/report-ramaswamy-tax-plan-would-gut-ohio-schools-medicaid/)
- **Vivek made about $260 million from a company whose Alzheimer's drug failed.** — Verdict: Fact. Axovant/Roivant — the drug failed its Phase 3 trial. (Source: Raw Story — https://www.rawstory.com/vivek-ramaswamy-2677693624/)
- **A California teachers' pension lost over $1 million on his company's stock.** — Verdict: Fact. CalSTRS' stake fell from $1.228M to $68K after the crash (SEC 13F filings). (Source: Raw Story — https://www.rawstory.com/vivek-ramaswamy-2677693624/)
- **He exited through a private SoftBank deal one month before the drug failure crashed the stock.** — Verdict: Fact. $1.1B SoftBank deal Aug 2017; Phase 3 failure Sept 2017 sent the stock down 70% in a day. (Source: Raw Story — https://www.rawstory.com/vivek-ramaswamy-2677693624/)

## The Conflicts
- **Vivek has a stake in a firm that funded every round of a company getting ~$830M in Ohio incentives.** — Verdict: Fact. 8VC Fund III backed every Anduril round; the governor oversees the incentive apparatus. (Source: Columbus Underground — https://columbusunderground.com/critics-ramaswamys-financial-ties-to-anduril-are-unacceptable-ocj1/)
- **One Ohio data center got a $4.5 million tax break for just 10 jobs.** — Verdict: Fact. Documented among Ohio's data-center incentive deals. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/vivek-ramaswamys-data-center-portfolio)
- **Ohio's data-center sales-tax break cost about $1.6 billion in 2025 — roughly 11x the estimate.** — Verdict: Fact. The exemption ran far past its ~$136M projection. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/vivek-ramaswamys-data-center-portfolio)
- **His personal investments span the whole data-center supply chain — chips, cloud, real estate, energy, even crypto.** — Verdict: Fact. NVIDIA/Intel (SHOC ETF he co-founded), Microsoft/Amazon/Apple, industrial REITs, Vistra, 19,000+ BTC via Strive. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/vivek-ramaswamys-data-center-portfolio)
- **As governor he'd appoint the boards that hand out data-center incentives and site the plants.** — Verdict: Fact. JobsOhio, the Tax Credit Authority, the Power Siting Board, and PUCO. (Source: Innovation Ohio — https://www.innovationohio.org/vivek-ramaswamys-data-center-portfolio)
